extra_vocab.en: only for one person or group, and not for everyone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇廣告中，exclusive discounts 指「只有會員才能享有的折扣」，用來強調優惠不是人人都有。廣告裡 exclusive 通常帶有「特別、限定」的正面語感。

example.en: This exclusive offer is available to new members only.
example.zh: 這項限定優惠只提供給新會員。

example.en: Our company has exclusive rights to sell this product.
example.zh: 我們公司擁有銷售這項產品的獨家權利。

example.en: Members get exclusive access to the online library.
example.zh: 會員可專屬使用線上圖書館。

example.en: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the CEO.
example.zh: 這本雜誌刊出了對執行長的獨家專訪。

examples.en: Subscribers will receive exclusive previews of our new products.
examples.zh: 訂閱者將收到我們新產品的專屬預覽。

examples.en: The room rate is exclusive of tax and service charges.
examples.zh: 房價不含稅金與服務費。

examples.en: The meeting room is for the exclusive use of managers.
examples.zh: 這間會議室僅供經理使用。

examples.en: The restaurant offers an exclusive menu for private events.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳為私人活動提供專屬菜單。

confusable.diff: inclusive 是「包含在內的」，exclusive 是「不含的、專屬的」。price exclusive of tax 是不含稅，price inclusive of tax 是含稅。
limited 強調數量或時間有限；exclusive 強調只有特定的人才能享有。

example.en: The price excludes shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 這個價格不包括運費與手續費。

example.en: The package includes a free one-year warranty.
example.zh: 這個方案包含免費一年保固。

example.en: The fee is inclusive of all meals and drinks.
example.zh: 這筆費用包含所有餐點與飲料。

example.en: This is a limited offer for the first fifty customers.
example.zh: 這是提供前五十位顧客的限量優惠。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇廣告中，complimentary carrying case 指「免費贈送的提袋」，是新會員的贈品。多益裡 complimentary 多半是「免費提供」的意思，語氣比 free 正式，常見於飯店、航空與廣告。

example.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 這家飯店每天早上提供免費早餐。

example.en: Each speaker will receive two complimentary tickets to the show.
example.zh: 每位講者將獲得兩張這場表演的招待券。

example.en: Customers who spend over fifty dollars get a complimentary gift.
example.zh: 消費超過五十美元的顧客可獲得免費贈品。

example.en: We will send you a complimentary copy of the report.
example.zh: 我們會寄給您一份報告的贈閱本。

examples.en: Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the building.
examples.zh: 住客可在整棟建築內使用免費無線網路。

examples.en: Passengers in first class receive complimentary drinks during the flight.
examples.zh: 頭等艙乘客在飛行期間可享用免費飲料。

examples.en: Thank you for your order. A complimentary sample is enclosed.
examples.zh: 感謝您的訂購，隨函附上免費試用品。

examples.en: The reviewer was very complimentary about the new design.
examples.zh: 評論者對新設計讚譽有加。

confusable.diff: complementary /ˌkɑːmpləˈmentri/ 是「互補的」，發音幾乎相同，只差一個字母。complimentary 是「免費的、讚美的」。
free 是日常用語；complimentary 較正式，常指企業為了服務或表達感謝而免費提供的東西。

example.en: Every new member will receive a small gift.
example.zh: 每位新會員都會收到一份小禮物。

example.en: Shipping is free for orders over one hundred dollars.
example.zh: 訂單超過一百美元可免運費。

example.en: You can use this voucher at any of our stores.
example.zh: 您可以在我們任何一家分店使用這張優惠券。

example.en: Staff members receive a discount on all products.
example.zh: 員工購買所有產品都可享折扣。
